issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Milkable.messageOnMilk(): the problem statement (UML and textual instructions) and the template expect a no-argument method messageOnMilk() returning a String (and examples show it should return "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"). The solution repository instead declares Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) and implements it with a double parameter in Seal and Goat. This parameter-list difference creates a contract mismatch: the template/Main calls messageOnMilk() with no arguments, whereas the solution's interface requires a double parameter. Students following the problem/template will implement a no-arg method and be confronted with a different signature in the provided solution, causing confusion and making the expected API inconsistent across artifacts.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Milkable API consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution to match the problem statement and template by updating the Milkable interface to declare String messageOnMilk() (no parameters) and update Seal and Goat to implement messageOnMilk() returning the format "[Animal Type] [name] is milked". Alternatively, if a volume parameter is intended pedagogically, update the problem statement UML, textual instructions, and template calls (Main) to document and use messageOnMilk(double volume) and show the expected return format including the volume.
